$Comment: The binding row for the game's own Gobliterator fight in the goblin Deepworks, its standard
mode (Goblin_Gobliterator_Encounter). The script shows a boss bar, so the library already runs
and credits the fight without a row; this row names it and keeps its records (wins, fastest
win, best share, damage) on Records' Boss Fights under the bucket goblin_gobliterator. Its hard
mode is a script of its own, Goblin_Gobliterator_Encounter_Hard, whose row keeps a tab of its
own under the game's hard-mode name.
Subject.TargetSlot names the script's own slot for the machine (Gobliterator), so the library
binds the boss it credits through every phase; a row left at the default Boss would bind
nothing. Beyond that it writes nothing on purpose: no Scale, Loot, Timing, Feedback or
Discovery, so the fight runs exactly as the game authored it, under the library's defaults (no
extra health, no pay, no map marker, no rest). Switch the row off with Enabled false, or from
